name: 80112 · Centennial, CO
findings: ZIP 80112 (Centennial) has 347 nonprofit organizations. 171 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 149 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80112 (Centennial) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80112 (Centennial) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 149 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
